
DESCRIPTION
Open the local Dashboard

USAGE
  one serve [flags]

TIPS
Starts a local Dashboard for workspaces, development services, project configuration, Infisical login, and shared credentials. The project Run tab provides start, stop, restart, a live console, and local access links. Review manifest changes before saving. Plaintext variables are fetched only when viewed or copied.

By default, binds to 127.0.0.1 on an available port and opens your browser. Closing the page keeps services running; Ctrl-C stops the Dashboard and its services. Host and Origin checks protect the interface.

COMMON OPTIONS
  --host <value>           Loopback host for the local settings page
  --open                   Open the settings page in the default browser
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  --port <value>           Local port (0 chooses an available port)
